newsitem.title: FRANCE: One missing as rains lash south-west France.
newsitem.headline: One missing as rains lash south-west France.

text.p: A motorist was missing after his car was swept away overnight in a flash flood as heavy rains lashed south-west France, France-Info radio said on Sunday.

Dozens of homes were flooded and their inhabitants evacuated by rubber dinghy in several towns including Beziers as rivers flooded their banks, rescue services said. The rains cut rail links and roads over a wide area near the Mediterranean coast.
